_comment: Bar-line edit of v3 take 2 (music_v1, seed 3313) onto the v3 film clock. A new take needs a new edit list. Times are on the musical grid (bars on even seconds); beatOffset is added to every time. Raw take (tools/audio-v3/work/music/v3/score.music_v1.seed3313.raw.mp3, 120 BPM, beats at 0.025 + k/2): sparse glockenspiel intro 0-8; bright groove 8-64 (G-F-E-D loop); a sustained low drone 64-73.5 that fades to silence by 76; a 1-bar riser 76-78; DROP on 78 (exactly where the plan put it); driving groove 78-126; a held chord 126-129 and a clean ring-out to silence by 133.9. Missing from the take: the hard stop, the heartbeat/tick tension, the blocked dip, the build and landing - all made here.

segments.why: M1-M3: the groove kicks in on hookLand (source bar 8 + 1 beat, so bars stay on even seconds) and runs to the hard stop
M4: hard stop at musicStop; Night falls (the muted pluck is an SFX)
drone again (sustained, the repeat is seamless), its fade to silence, the 1-bar riser, the DROP on 76, the tech groove
M8/M9: the landing repeats one groove bar, then the held chord on 126 and the ring-out

gain.why: the drone sits under the heartbeat
near silence after the sub hit (the take's own fade continues to 74)

sweeps.why: Night: the drone darkened to a low pad
M7: the band drops to bass and tick for 2 bars
M8: high-pass build, snapping back full on the landing

synth.why: M4: low heartbeat pulse from musicStop + 2 s
M4: dull thud when the slip is used

subHits.why: M4: the deep sub hit (subHit) before 'So how does a buyer know it's clean?'

cues.what: glockenspiel pickup; the groove kicks in on hookLand 2.5
bright groove (no 8-bar builds or comic break in the take)
the same groove (the take has no separate chorus)
hard stop on 58, silence to 60, dark drone + heartbeat + ticks, thud 66, sub hit 68, near silence
fade to silence, 1-bar riser 74-76, DROP on 76
bass + tick for 2 bars (110-114), band back 114-116
high-pass build 116-122, LANDING on 122 (sub hit, full band)
held chord on 126, clean ring-out, silent from 133.5
